title: Web service C2 (pastebin/GitHub)
hypothesis: C2 used public web services to host content (pastebin, gist, raw URLs).
queries: DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemoteUrl has_any ('pastebin.com','gist.github.com','raw.githubusercontent.com') | where InitiatingProcessFileName != 'browser'
rationale: Public-service fetches from odd processes = stager.
